unit:
[Unit]
Description=agentcron scheduler

[Service]
ExecStart="/SCRATCH/agentcron" "--config" "/SCRATCH/m3-config" "--data-dir" "/SCRATCH/m3-data" "daemon"
Restart=on-failure
KillMode=mixed
TimeoutStopSec=30
Environment="PATH=/fake/bin"
Environment="MDKB_ROOT=/SCRATCH/kb"

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
